--- firmware/base_image.bin (binary/image, not excerpted) ---
--- firmware/ecu_delta_container.bin (binary/image, not excerpted) ---
--- protocol/calibration_stamp.txt ---
CALIBRATION STAMP / DELTA FORGE

FAMILY             GEELY-DELTA-FORGE-7
ROOT ID            C64A8C1BB751D6CC
ROOT SEQUENCE      0000
FINAL SEQUENCE     000C
BASE IMAGE SIZE    0x2000
MANIFEST OFFSET    0x1F00
MANIFEST LENGTH    0x60

The base image is immutable.
The delta container is the authorized update vector.

--- protocol/forge_protocol.txt ---
DELTA FORGE PROTOCOL / REVISION 7

Firmware artifacts:
  base_image.bin              immutable baseline image
  ecu_delta_container.bin     encrypted patch vector

Container is a vector of records:
  uint16 BE payload length, then payload bytes.

For sequence S, decrypt payload with:
  SHA256(FAMILY || parent_id || uint16be(S)) repeated.

A valid plaintext patch:
  +00 EC 4F
  +02 offset uint16 BE
  +04 op uint8
  +05 length uint8
  +06 data[length]
  +06+len chain hint uint16 BE
  +08+len xor checksum uint8

Patch operations on each byte:
  A0 overwrite
  A1 xor
  A2 add mod 256
  A3 rotate left by data byte mod 8

Checksum is XOR of every prior plaintext byte.

Chain hint must equal first two bytes of:
  SHA256(FAMILY || image_after_patch || uint16be(S))
The next parent_id is the first eight bytes of that digest.

There are twelve real patches. Other records are decoys.

After sequence 12, decrypt the manifest at 0x1F00, length 0x60.
MANIFEST_KEY =
  SHA256(FAMILY || base_image[0x0000:0x1F00] ||
         uint16be(12) || ASCII("MANIFEST"))

Manifest is XOR-encrypted with the repeating key.
Strip 0xA5 padding after decryption.

CTF challenge statement (Chinese), 2026-Zeekr-Cybersecurity-Quals (CTF-Archives public dump). Statement:

一辆测试车的 ECU 收到过一个“看起来像正常升级”的固件差分包。真正可用的补丁链被混在多条诱饵记录里，manifest 又被单独加密。你需要从基线镜像和加密差分向量中重建完整的补丁链，并恢复最终固件里的安全 manifest。 flag大写 flag 格式 GEELY{DELTA_...}
Hint:
载体没有文件系统、magic number 或明文 manifest。真实页需要同时满足 CRC、状态、reserved marker 和 mosaic table。掩码依赖 family、page id 和 order，不能直接异或原始页数据。
